gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Carrois Gothic SC keeps its curves open at every terminal and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, while Snowburst One cuts bold stencil bridges above it. Paragraphs in it go down smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-chivo: Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet, bold and expressive, with wide bridges between its tall lowercase letters. Chivo sits beneath in sans-serif, its lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight showing through every curve.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-chocolate-classi: Stencil bridges slice through every Snowburst One letter, giving the heading its loud, expressive punch. But Chocolate Classical Sans is the one that handles the sizable lowercase, with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-comme: Comme runs smooth and modern, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height with no clogged curves anywhere. Snowburst One, meanwhile, brings the stencil-cut boldness above it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-cossette-texte: Loud stencil cuts up top, then a plain sans below with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height. Snowburst One's gaps cut low against Cossette Texte's full strokes.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-duru-sans: Modern and clean, Duru Sans opens wide on small letters, its bodies dominating the line while ascenders barely show, under Snowburst One's stencil bridges. Text in it moves along steadily.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-fresca: Stencil-cut and bold, Snowburst One has wide bridges, while Fresca is built from single-weight strokes with connected counters and short ascenders above big bowls. Reading it flows easily.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths constant from stem to curve, with a lowercase e opened like a pried clasp. Snowburst One's bold stencil sheet above it supplies the volume, and the sans hums quietly below as a flat gray texture.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-gafata: Contemporary in feel, Gafata forms a tall band of letters with short stalks above and wide-eyed lowercase e shapes. Snowburst One handles the bold, expressive stencil work, and Gafata handles the steady text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-geist: Professional and clean, Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, so its words read as solid blocks rather than skylines. Snowburst One earns its place big and short.
